title: Used to be flawless

This app used to be flawless but they keep adding new features that are just frustrating to interact with, especially in situations where you might not have a strong Wi-Fi connection at the time. Most notably, smart shuffle has completely changed the binary operation of shuffle/unshuffle. What they need to do is decouple this functionality from the existing shuffle and make it a toggleable feature. The problems with smart shuffle are numerous, but IΓÇÖll just name the main ones I can think of 

Smart shuffle being enabled then disabled by cycling through the shuffle buttonΓÇÖs operations interrupts your currently selected play schedule. For example. If I search my liked songs for an album and I want to just play the album in order, I canΓÇÖt just simply tap on the song I want to start from and have the album loop unless the last thing I was listening to was unshuffled as well. If the last thing you listened to was shuffled, it remembers that option. So then I have to go and unshuffle (which turns on smart shuffle) and then turn off smart shuffle. If you are on cellular data, this process takes like 10-30 seconds.  This process seems to break the existing play schedule that I had queued up, and I am then forced to go and search again for what I want to listen to and then tap the song I want to start from. 

The fact that this feature is not optional, yet adds frustrating workarounds and limitations just to retain pre-existing functionality is a disgrace to standard app design practices.
